mods.name: Valhalla Echoes
mods.description: Awaken the legends of the North! Valhalla Echoes introduces fearsome Mystical Vikings to Minecraft, featuring uniquely modeled 3D equipment like the iconic Horned Helmet and powerful mystical weaponry. Brace yourself for the sounds of battle as you encounter these ancient warriors.

releases.notes:
## Valhalla Echoes `v0.6.2-beta` (Minecraft 26.3 • Fabric)

The **Viking Clan System** is here! Explore regional clan territories, earn standing with the four Nordic clans, bring offerings, and fight alongside allied Vikings.

### Highlights
- **Viking Clan Reputation System:** Track your standing (**Hostile**, **Neutral**, **Friendly**, **Ally**) across **Wolf**, **Raven**, **Bear**, and **Serpent** clans, saved per world (`-100` to `+150`).
- **Cross-Clan Rivalries:** Helping a clan slightly lowers your standing with its rival (`Wolf ↔ Serpent`, `Bear ↔ Raven`), while still leaving room for reconciliation.
- **3D Clan `TargeShield` Variants:** `Mystical Vikings` now carry 3D clan shields matching their clan emblem (and shields tagged with `valhalla-echoes:clan` render the matching emblem in-hand and while blocking).
- **Offerings & Blessings:** Interact with Vikings using valuables (`Runic Gem`, `Mystical Ingot`, `Mystical Essence`, `Gold Ingot`, `Emerald`) or clan-favorite items (e.g., meats/bones for **Wolf**, ender pearls/amethyst/feathers for **Raven**, honey/salmon/sweet berries for **Bear**, nautilus shells/prismarine/emeralds for **Serpent**) to build reputation and receive gifts or **Strength / Regeneration** blessings from Allies.
- **Dynamic Clan AI & World Events:**
  - Vikings react to your clan reputation instead of vanilla Piglin gold/armor rules.
  - Slaying **Draugrs** near Vikings (or within clan territory) earns reputation and triggers celebrations.
  - Attacking a Viking drops reputation and alerts nearby clan members.
- **`/clan` Command:** Check your reputation with `/clan` or `/clan status`, inspect your current territory with `/clan region`, and manage clan standings/NPCs with `/clan reputation` and `/clan assign`.
- **Populated Viking Villages:** Villages now generate with persistent resident Vikings inside huts and patrolling roads, belonging to the region's clan.

### Fixes & Technical Updates
- Prevented broken Minecraft 26.3 baby models by keeping `MysticalVikingEntity` strictly adult.
- Fixed `viking_village` structure `spawn_overrides` (`monster` category, `full` bounding box).
- Updated translations across all 11 supported languages (`en_us`, `es_es`, `es_mx`, `pt_br`, `pt_pt`, `de_de`, `fr_fr`, `it_it`, `ru_ru`, `zh_cn`, `zh_tw`).

### Requirements
- **Minecraft:** `26.3`
- **Fabric Loader:** `0.20.1+`
- **Fabric API:** `0.166.2+26.3`
- **Java:** `25+`

## Valhalla Echoes v0.6.1-beta — Clan Banners & Heraldry Update

**Minecraft:** `26.3` | **Loader:** `Fabric 0.20.1+` | **Java:** `25+`

---

### What's New in v0.6.1-beta

#### Viking Clans & Regional Village Heraldry
Every **512×512** region of your world is now claimed by one of four ancient Viking Clans:
- **Wolf Clan** *(Gray emblem)*
- **Raven Clan** *(Cyan emblem)*
- **Bear Clan** *(Red emblem)*
- **Serpent Clan** *(Green emblem)*

When discovering **Viking Villages** in snowy biomes, each settlement will fly the heraldic banners of its ruling clan across huts and halls—and you can find their **Clan Banner Pattern** scrolls hidden inside village chests!

#### Custom Banner & Shield Patterns
- Added **4 new Banner Pattern items**:
  - **Wolf Banner Pattern** (`valhalla-echoes:wolf_banner_pattern`)
  - **Raven Banner Pattern** (`valhalla-echoes:raven_banner_pattern`)
  - **Bear Banner Pattern** (`valhalla-echoes:bear_banner_pattern`)
  - **Serpent Banner Pattern** (`valhalla-echoes:serpent_banner_pattern`)
- Fully compatible with the **Loom**: craft custom clan **Banners** and apply your clan's emblem directly onto **Shields** using any dye color.
- Custom pixel-art scroll textures, banner textures, and shield textures designed specifically for Minecraft `26.3`.

#### Fixes & Polish
- Fixed missing item texture/model on the **Draugr Spawn Egg** (`valhalla-echoes:draugr_spawn_egg`).
- Added localization strings for all new clan banner pattern items across all **11 supported languages** (`en_us`, `es_es`, `es_mx`, `pt_br`, `pt_pt`, `de_de`, `fr_fr`, `it_it`, `zh_cn`, `zh_tw`, `ru_ru`).

---

### Requirements
- **Minecraft:** `26.3`
- **Fabric Loader:** `0.20.1` or higher
- **Fabric API:** `0.166.2+26.3` or higher
- **Java:** `25+`

---
### Disclaimer
Version 0.6.0 Beta was skipped because of sync problems with GitHub, first added the structure and blank banners without textures, now it was completely implemented in this version (0.6.1).

## What's Changed
* Update for 26.3 by @SebasMata in https://github.com/SebasMata/valhalla-echoes/pull/25


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SebasMata/valhalla-echoes/compare/v0.4.0-alpha...v0.5.0-beta

## Summary
Port **Valhalla Echoes** from Minecraft `1.21.11` to **Minecraft `26.3`** (Fabric) and bump the mod version to **`v0.5.0-beta`**.

## Changes

### Build & Dependencies
- Updated `gradle.properties`:
  - `minecraft_version`: `1.21.11` → `26.3`
  - `loader_version`: `0.18.4` → `0.20.1`
  - `loom_version`: `1.15-SNAPSHOT` → `1.19-SNAPSHOT`
  - `fabric_api_version`: `0.141.3+1.21.11` → `0.166.2+26.3`
  - `mod_version`: `v0.4.0-alpha` → `v0.5.0-beta`
- Updated `build.gradle`:
  - Switched Loom plugin from `net.fabricmc.fabric-loom-remap` to `net.fabricmc.fabric-loom` (unobfuscated releases in `26.x`).
  - Removed `mappings loom.officialMojangMappings()` and migrated `modImplementation` to `implementation`.
  - Bumped Java compilation and compatibility level from Java 21 to **Java 25**.
- Updated Gradle Wrapper to `9.8.2` (`gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties`).
- Updated `fabric.mod.json` dependency constraints (`fabricloader >=0.20.1`, `minecraft ~26.3`, `java >=25`).
- Updated Mixin `compatibilityLevel` to `JAVA_25` in `valhalla-echoes.mixins.json` and `valhalla-echoes.client.mixins.json`.
- Updated `README.md` to reflect Minecraft `26.3` and `v0.5.0-beta`.

### Code & API Migration
- **Tools (`MysticalShovelItem.java`):** Changed superclass from the removed `ShovelItem` to `Item` and applied `properties.shovel(...)` directly in the constructor.
- **Creative Tabs (`ModItems.java`):** Migrated `ItemGroupEvents.modifyEntriesEvent` to `CreativeModeTabEvents.modifyOutputEvent`.
- **Entity AI (`MysticalVikingEntity.java`, `MysticalVikingAi.java`):**
  - Migrated `EntityType.PLAYER` / `EntityType.PIGLIN` to `EntityTypes.PLAYER` / `EntityTypes.PIGLIN`.
  - Updated brain initialization to use `Brain.Provider`, `Brain.Packed`, and `ActivityData.create(...)`.
- **Combat Mixin (`TargeShieldMixin.java`):** Updated `LivingEntity#knockback` call to pass `DamageSource` and `amount`.
- **Client Rendering (`ValhallaEchoesClient.java`):** Migrated `EntityModelLayerRegistry` to `ModelLayerRegistry` and updated `ArmorRenderer.submitTransformCopyingModel(...)` to match the new signature.

### Data & Worldgen
- **Structure Spawns (`viking_village.json`):** Updated `spawn_overrides` from deprecated `minCount`/`maxCount` fields to the new `count` `IntProvider` (`minecraft:uniform`) format.

## Testing
- Verified successful compilation and packaging via `./gradlew build`.
- Launched `:runClient` in Minecraft `26.3`, created a new world, and confirmed world loading without data/codec errors.
